88 Bluxome Street and Bay Club SF Tennis Interim Site Project
2015-012490ENV


Correction: on June 19, 2019 the Planning Department published a newspaper ad which incorrectly stated that there is a 30-day period for public comments and/or appeals of the determination that no environmental impact report (EIR) is required for the Bay Club SF Tennis Interim Site component of the proposed project. Pursuant to Administrative Code section 31.16 the public comment and appeal period is 20 days from the date of publication (until 5:00 p.m. on July 9, 2019).
